title: Degenerate layout object
description: Layout-quality rule — a layout object is degenerate. Text objects without any text, objects with zero width or height, and objects below the minimum size in both dimensions (width/height sliders, default 4 px each). Lines are excluded — zero extent is their normal shape. Tiny empty texts are often used as spacers; review before deleting.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Zero-size and sub-minimum objects are invisible in Layout mode yet still render, evaluate hide conditions and take part in the tab order. Empty text objects are usually paste or refactoring leftovers.
rule.remediation: Delete degenerate objects — but check tiny empty texts first, they are sometimes used deliberately as spacers.
